svg.title: 01 Database Schema
svg.desc: Spendly v1.2.0 implementation-aligned technical figure. All wireframe values are illustrative.
svg.text: Physical application schema | PostgreSQL | 11 tables, 97 columns and 10 foreign-key relationships
Version values are text, not model_versions FKs.
One user owns zero or many records in each of six child tables.
One analysis run has zero or one forecast (unique foreign key).
PK = primary key FK = foreign key UQ = unique ? = nullable
Run -> alerts / recommendations: 1 to 0..*. Transaction -> alerts: 0..1 to 0..*.
Foreign keys use ON DELETE CASCADE except anomaly_alerts.transaction_id (SET NULL). Result version strings are not foreign keys. Crossed
target_id is intentionally not an FK.
Admin identity is configured outside the users table. No admin role, feedback, category or inferred-schedule
table is invented here. Full SQL types, unique constraints and indexes are in the accompanying data dictionary.
Source: backend/app/models/entities.py | UUIDs stored as varchar(36); timestamps use UTC; money uses numeric(14,2).
